cases.description: NB1 4XY, the full sample postcode: every counted topic has something recorded.

rule.source: FE-38, FE-39 and FE-41 (docs/product), as written in the Task 3 plan: counted topics only; found = recorded, stale or no-record-in-source; not known = records all source-failed (or mixed with not-covered); not covered = left out; one question per record

inputs.note: Registry from pilot-topics.json, records from postcode-area.json (synthetic).

steps.description: Counted topics, in registry order (family-view and the five route-only topics are counted: false and ignored): getting-around, everyday-places, places-of-worship, schools, planning-nearby, flood, crime, sold-nearby, broadband, air-quality, council-tax-by-band, housing-affordability, deprivation, transport-connectivity, green-space.
getting-around: transport-stop 1 to 3 and bus-departures 1 to 4 are all recorded, so found.
everyday-places: amenity 1 to 5 recorded (supermarket, park, pharmacy, gp-surgery, police-station), amenity 6 (childcare) is no-record-in-source. Found; the childcare record gets a question.
places-of-worship: amenity 7, 8, 9 recorded, found.
schools: school 1 and 2 recorded, school-inspection 1 stale and 2 recorded, school-demand 1 and 2 recorded, found.
flood: FLOOD-1 is no-record-in-source and FLOOD-RISK-POSTCODE-1 is recorded, found; FLOOD-1 gets a question.

The other ten counted topics each have recorded records only, found (planning-nearby, crime, sold-nearby, broadband, air-quality, council-tax-by-band, housing-affordability, deprivation, transport-connectivity, green-space).
found 15, not known 0, coverage 15 of 15. Questions: only the two no-record-in-source records, in registry then file order. Check in person: all 15 topics (all found).

Question text comes from each topic's gapQuestionTemplate, never from the record label. The only slot is {subject}: for everyday-places it is the plain name of the record's subtype (childcare -> 'childcare', supermarket -> 'supermarket'); every other topic's template has no slot, so its text is the template as written. Two flood records in NB7 1RR give the same question twice, one per record.

questions.text: Which childcare do people living here use, and how far away is it?
Has the home or the street ever flooded, and is there a flood history for the property?

cases.description: NB7 1RR, the sparse test postcode: gaps of every kind.

rule.source: FE-38, FE-39 and FE-41 (docs/product), as written in the Task 3 plan: counted topics only; found = recorded, stale or no-record-in-source; not known = records all source-failed (or mixed with not-covered); not covered = left out; one question per record

inputs.note: Registry from pilot-topics.json, records from postcode-area.json (synthetic).

steps.description: Same 15 counted topics as NB1 4XY.
getting-around: transport-stop 1 recorded, bus-departures 1 no-record-in-source. Found (any recorded), question for the bus-departures record.
everyday-places: amenity 2 (supermarket) no-record-in-source. Found, with a question. places-of-worship: amenity 1 recorded, found.
schools: school 1 recorded, school-demand 1 not-covered. Found, with a question for the not-covered record.
flood: FLOOD-1 and FLOOD-RISK-POSTCODE-1 are both source-failed: not known, two questions.
transport-connectivity: its only record is source-failed: not known, one question.
green-space: its only record is not-covered: not covered, left out of found, not known and the total; still one question.

sold-nearby, air-quality and housing-affordability each hold one no-record-in-source record: found, one question each. planning-nearby, crime, broadband, council-tax-by-band, deprivation and places-of-worship are recorded: found.

Found: getting-around, everyday-places, places-of-worship, schools, planning-nearby, crime, sold-nearby, broadband, air-quality, council-tax-by-band, housing-affordability, deprivation = 12. Not known = 2 (flood, transport-connectivity). Coverage total 12 + 2 = 14. Questions 10 (records that are not recorded). Check in person: the 14 found or not-known topics.

Question text comes from each topic's gapQuestionTemplate, never from the record label. The only slot is {subject}: for everyday-places it is the plain name of the record's subtype (childcare -> 'childcare', supermarket -> 'supermarket'); every other topic's template has no slot, so its text is the template as written. Two flood records in NB7 1RR give the same question twice, one per record.

cases.description: One counted topic whose only record is not-covered: left out of every count.

rule.source: FE-38, FE-39 and FE-41 (docs/product), as written in the Task 3 plan: counted topics only; found = recorded, stale or no-record-in-source; not known = records all source-failed (or mixed with not-covered); not covered = left out; one question per record

steps.description: alpha has one record, not-covered, so the topic is not covered.
Left out: found 0, not known 0, coverage 0 of 0. One question (the record is not-covered). No check-in-person list (not found, not known).
Question text: gap template 'Gap question about {subject}', no subtype, so subject = topic name in lower case = 'alpha'.

cases.description: Recorded with source-failed, not-covered with source-failed, and one record shared by two topics.

rule.source: FE-38, FE-39 and FE-41 (docs/product), as written in the Task 3 plan: counted topics only; found = recorded, stale or no-record-in-source; not known = records all source-failed (or mixed with not-covered); not covered = left out; one question per record

steps.description: alpha: recorded + source-failed. Something is found, so found. The source-failed record gets a question.
beta: not-covered + source-failed. Nothing found and not all not-covered, so not known. Two questions (both records are gaps).
gamma and delta both read the record S2-SHARED-1 (no-record-in-source): both found. The record is asked about once, under gamma (first in registry order).
found 3 (alpha, gamma, delta), not known 1 (beta), coverage 3 of 4. Questions 4: S2-A-2, S2-B-1, S2-B-2, S2-SHARED-1. Check in person: all four topics.

Question text: subject = subtypeNames[subtype] if the record has a subtype, else the topic name in lower case. S2-B-1 has subtype 'widget' (named 'widget'): 'Gap question about widget'. S2-A-2 -> alpha, S2-B-2 -> beta (no subtype), S2-SHARED-1 -> gamma (first topic in registry order).
